summary: Texas Ventures Acquisition IV Corp filed Form 8-K reporting the completion of its IPO and concurrent private placement on June 22, 2026. The company sold 17.25M units at $10.00/unit, each consisting of one Class A share and one-half warrant, raising $172.5M in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, it sold 6.1M private placement warrants at $1.00/warrant to sponsor TXV Partners IV and underwriter Cohen, generating $6.1M. Net proceeds of $173.36M were placed in trust. The filing confirms the SPAC's formation and funding, with the trust serving as collateral for future de-SPAC. No target is announced; watch for a business combination announcement within the typical 24-month window, with risk-arb spread hinging on deal terms and shareholder redemption.
